Lifetime access to Vizolog
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Vizologi plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say Vizologi may terminate the license and suspend access at any time, which materially limits the promise of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: This license shall automatically terminate if you violate any of these restrictions and may be terminated by Vizologi at any time.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access can be terminated at any time by the vendor, so it is not unconditional lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Vizologi may suspend your access to the Vizologi service at any time, including the unauthorized use, whether real or alleged, of the Vizologi service or its content, or the breach of the Terms of Service.
exhibits.argument: Access may be suspended at any time, which undermines a promise of guaranteed lifetime access.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 30,000 AI credits per month, 5 lists and 5 projects per month
trials.claimQuote:
Stack up to 4 codes
- 30,000 AI credits per month
- 5 lists per month
- 5 projects per month
trials.reasoning: Reviews show one AI project can cost 20,000 to 50,000 credits and about 120,000 credits yields only 6 to 9 projects, so 30,000 credits cannot realistically deliver 5 AI projects per month.

exhibits.quote: Even on Tier 4, generating a single project via AI can cost between 20,000 to 50,000 credits or more.
exhibits.argument: A single project can consume most or all of the monthly credits, so 5 projects per month is not realistically achievable.

exhibits.quote: Consequently, with a total of approximately 120,000 credits, one can typically complete only about 6 to 9 projects.
exhibits.argument: Real usage shows credit limits yield far fewer projects than the advertised monthly allowances imply.
